channel.title: The Global Meridian – International News Wire
channel.description: Authoritative, verified global journalism from international news bureaus across Geneva, Tokyo, Washington, London, New Delhi, and Dhaka.

item.title: White House Announces Unprecedented US-China-Russia Trilateral Summit at APEC for Strategic Nuclear Talks
item.description: Washington confirms preparations for a rare three-way leadership meeting between US, Chinese, and Russian presidents on the sidelines of the APEC summit focused on strategic arms stability.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: WMO Warns at COP31 Antalya That 2026 Ranks Among Warmest Years Amid Super El Niño and Record Ocean Heat
item.description: As UN climate talks in Antalya enter week two, the World Meteorological Organization reports record-breaking ocean temperatures, rising sea levels, and urgent EU climate-health action.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: OECD Projects 2.9% Global Economic Growth in 2026 Driven by AI Infrastructure Boom as UK Expands 0.7% in Q3
item.description: Sustained capital expenditures in data centers, power grids, and enterprise AI outpace energy volatility, lifting UK third-quarter output to its fastest pace in over two years.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Industry Shifts Toward "Physical AI" as Autonomous Robotics and Grid-Scale Compute Capex Surge Worldwide
item.description: Enterprise technology leaders move beyond chat interfaces to deploy agentic software and embodied robotics across semiconductor fabs, logistics ports, and scientific laboratories.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: WEF and Frontiers Spotlight Direct Lithium Extraction, Grid-Interactive EVs, and Personalized mRNA Cancer Vaccines
item.description: Joint international scientific assessment highlights three breakthrough technologies moving from laboratory prototypes to commercial global scale in 2026.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Strait of Hormuz Maritime Security Alerts Intensify as Global Allies Review Strategic Defense Posture and Satellite Resilience
item.description: Heightened naval monitoring across Middle Eastern shipping lanes coincides with accelerated multi-year defense modernization plans and orbital reconnaissance deployments.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: SAFF Championship: Defending Champions India Edge Bhutan 2-1 to Reach Regional Football Final
item.description: A spirited second-half performance seals India's berth in the South Asian Football Federation championship decider after a fiercely contested semifinal.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: International Film Festival of India Sets 159 Global Films Under "Stories Without Borders" Theme Ahead of Goa Opening
item.description: The 57th IFFI opens Nov 20 with Paweł Pawlikowski's Cannes-winning "Fatherland" alongside 159 international selections chosen from over 1,400 global submissions.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)
